Description: Cell body detections in raw stitched image voxel space. Detected using ClearMap2 (Renier et al. 2016, updated pipeline). Columns: z, y, x are voxel indices in the full stitched image coordinate system (before resampling). intensity_mean and intensity_max are fluorescence values at the detected coordinate extracted from the raw image.

z.Description: Z voxel coordinate (A-P axis in raw space)

y.Description: Y voxel coordinate (D-V axis in raw space)

x.Description: X voxel coordinate (M-L axis in raw space)

intensity_mean.Description: Mean fluorescence intensity of detected cell

intensity_max.Description: Peak fluorescence intensity of detected cell
